properties.data: 2）warfarin metabolism can be reduced and the concentration of warfarin in patients can be increased by interfering CYPs；（3）warfarin distribution is affected，the binding effect of warfarin with non -protein is increased，and its anticoagulant effect is enhanced. Interaction drugs include commonly used cardiotonic drugs （digoxin），anti-arrhythmia drugs （amiodarone），lipid-lowering drugs （pravastatin，fluvastatin， etc.），antiplatelet drugs （clopidogrel，aspirin，etc.），uric acid lowering drugs （benbromarone），proton pump inhibitors and hypoglycemic drugs（metformin）. Warfarin's anticoagulant effect can be affected by its interactions with other drugs. Therefore，the research progress of warfarin interaction with commonly used drugs for cardiovascular diseases was reviewed，in order to provide guidance for the clinical application of warfarin.Keywords: Warfarin；Cardiovascular disease；
